note: Unmarked subagent summaries (no nonce), over the boundary rows no earlier copy has joined (joined_before: agents whose row a copy earlier in the session already took): fill joins by body sha (b), else by time (c). The (c) candidate count is core's built reading (core-escalations E-C9-10, provisional until the root rules): every agent with an unjoined boundary row within SUB_WINDOW_S (120 s) on either side of the PostCompact time counts; a fill only when there is exactly one and its row lies in the reconcile.pm P3 sub window (at most TOL_S, 2 s, before and at most SUB_WINDOW_S after the PostCompact time); several give copy_attribution_ambiguous. The two boundary rows are 35 s apart. The summary rows carry the engine trailers: a reader computing the row's normalized-body sha must cut them first, or join (b) never matches (fix-escalations item 1; core built option (b), its own cut in transcript.pm; `--check` cuts the same three prefixes, ENGINE_TRAILERS). verify-fail is time-join with the test-mode fault that flips one byte of the new file before the re-read.
